page.overview:
Who is Dissin' Flies?

The Dissin' Flies are supporting characters in A Bug's Life.

"Every audience has a few smart aleck bugs in it. "Hey, cutie, wanna pollinate with a real bug?" one yells at Francis. Bad call. Francis hates being mistaken for a girl. These two flies have definitely dissed the wrong bug."

While sitting in the audience at P.T. Flea's circus and heckling the performance, the Dissin' Flies mistakenly flirt with Francis, believing him to be a girl. Annoyed by this, Francis furiously picks a fight with them, angrily saying that "Judging by their breath, they must had been buzzing around a dung heap all day!".

The Dissin' Flies and the other flies enjoy P.T.'s Flaming Death act, especially when it went completely wrong and P.T. was set alight (even a fly saying, "Burn him again!").
